component.name: Quillbinder
component.summary: Write, organize and compile long texts

description.p: Quillbinder is a writing studio for long texts such as novels, theses and screenplays. It keeps a manuscript as a binder of chapters, scenes and notes, with a corkboard, an outliner, a combined text view, snapshots, targets, mind maps and object sheets for characters and places, and it compiles the manuscript to Word, PDF and EPUB.

Quillbinder can open and save projects in Scrivener 3 format (.scriv), so that projects can move between the programs. It is an independent program, not made by or connected with Literature & Latte, the maker of Scrivener.
This is an alpha version: keep backups of your projects.
First release on the project page: AppImage, add-ons and the source code of every library.
